topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: The air feels thick, heavier than usual. The space between the trees seems smaller, the shadows longer. I dart between the trunks, the underbrush scratching at my paws. Every step makes a sound too loud, echoing through the still woods. I can’t shake the sense of being watched, eyes that are not there pressing into my back. The scent of the forest, usually a comfort, is now a chaotic mix of scents that tangle and confuse. I need to find a place to wait, to listen, to understand the shift in the air before I can move on. The usual paths, the familiar markers, offer no guidance now. I must be cautious, more than ever.
